## Description

Distribution-free conformal inference wrapper applied around predictive ML models to generate mathematically guaranteed prediction intervals.

## Where it may fit

High-uncertainty regime transitions, earnings events, macro data release shocks, and dynamic risk-adjusted position sizing.

## Vehicles

Institutional quantitative funds, systematic risk-parity desks, retail API execution models.

## Required data

Out-of-sample calibration dataset residuals, ML model predictions, real-time market features.

## Caveats

Guarantees valid finite-sample coverage $1-\alpha$ assuming exchangeability or adaptive non-stationary conformal extensions.
